dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Have you heard that Trump is detaining green-card holders? It's crazy! His chính sách nhập cư is getting increasingly harsh.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: You always talk about Trump's chính sách nhập cư. I don't care much about it. But... I once feared deportation when I was still in Russia. That feeling was truly kinh khủng.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I'm sorry, I didn't know you went through that. Chính sách nhập cư affects more people than we think. Sometimes I forget you're also an immigrant.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: It's okay. But it is kinh khủng to think about being expelled from a place you consider home. I've felt safe in Saigon, but I'm still worried about the future...

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I promise I won't let that happen to you. Chính sách nhập cư may change, but I'll always be here for you. We can find a way...
